description: The tab bar of the main-dock layout, with buttons that show or hide the side panels (Changes, CI, Pending, PRs and more) from dock/panels.json. The gear menu sets the order of the buttons and hides the ones you do not use.

settings.label: Button density
settings.hint: Auto shows the names of the bar buttons from 2250 px of bar width. Shared by the Kanban bar and the Dock bar.

settings.label: Where panels open
settings.hint: Auto opens a panel at the side when the window is wide, else in a dialog. Shared by the Kanban bar and the Dock bar.
